candidate_updates.blocker_update: Relevant external solver code is now public, so code nonexistence is not a blocker. Pre-solver formal kernel tests remain feasible, but observed-sector interpretation is still blocked until a pinned external-transfer intake passes convention, interpolation, mask, covariance, nuisance-rank, and injection-recovery validation; no web source establishes the repository's current rank-two kernel as physical.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: Pontzen and Challinor's scalar/vector/tensor linearization, Pereira and Pitrou's super-curvature correspondence, and the 2026 AniLoS/AniCLASS line-of-sight implementations already supply sector-labelled dynamics and external deterministic multipoles. The remaining differentiator is a repository-specific admissible-cone response operator with constructive kernel witnesses and explicit nuisance-conditioned rank, not the sector decomposition itself.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: No solver or observational data are required, but the rebuild must encode all-observer, congruence, matter, expansion, differentiability, vorticity/acceleration, and radiation-multipole premises as applicable. The 2022 counterexample makes a premise-free almost-FLRW converse untenable; two independent derivations and regeneration tests remain decisive local gates.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: The exact Ehlers-Geren-Sachs theorem, the conditional 1995 almost-EGS theorem, and modern Einstein-Vlasov counterexamples already define the central implication and its failure modes. The defensible novelty is therefore an executable, frame-typed premise DAG and counterexample registry that prevents unsupported converses across repository consumers, not a new general EGS theorem.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: Public AniLoS/AniCLASS weakens the external-code blocker, so a transfer-conditional graph prototype can be built against pinned outputs. The candidate remains native-solver-dependent for scientific family components because there is still no validated native morphology atlas, declared family-equivalence registry, matched mask/null/covariance campaign, or held-out proof that graph components are invariant enough under parameterization and nuisance projection.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: ANICOSMO/Planck already implement deterministic-template Bianchi likelihoods, physical-versus-phenomenological coupling, masking, orientation scans, and simulation checks; Pontzen-Challinor and Pereira-Pitrou supply typed mode blocks, while AniLoS/AniCLASS now supply public external multipoles. A unified nuisance-projected equivalence graph spanning mean, covariance, local/global, and systematics responses remains a plausible interface contribution, but physical family nodes are not yet authenticated.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: There is no external method-availability blocker. Rebuild one symmetric calibration implementation and prove super-uniformity, tie handling, finite-Monte-Carlo uncertainty, and identical observation/null preprocessing at every operational simulation count; matched end-to-end sky/systematics nulls remain mandatory for a scientific result rather than an algorithmic repair.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: Exact random-permutation p-values, observation-inclusive finite ranks, and dependence-preserving Westfall-Young calibration are established statistical methods. The publishable contribution can only be the diagnosis and repair of this repository's asymmetric two-stage low-ell scan, plus operational coverage evidence under its frozen statistic and null generators.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: External deterministic multipole code is publicly available as of 2026, but neither the paper nor repositories provide a validated native low-ell morphology atlas, family-equivalence quotient, globally calibrated cross-family trials, or matched mask/beam/foreground/covariance null suite. Interface and synthetic negative tests may proceed; any family-compatible set remains native-solver-dependent and hypothesis-only.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: Planck and ANICOSMO already performed physical and phenomenological Bianchi VII_h likelihood analyses with orientation/parameter scans, masking, polarization template tests, and simulations, and current AniLoS/AniCLASS generates several nearly-isotropic model limits. The distinct proposal is a held-out, coverage-calibrated, set-valued quotient over predeclared morphology-equivalence classes rather than a best-family winner.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: Raw catalogue access is no longer a categorical blocker because EDD exposes individual, grouped, and velocity tables. Provenance remains insufficient for retention: the candidate still needs authenticated selection and grouping lineage, distance-calibration and Malmquist response, correlated peculiar-velocity mocks, estimator-window and north/south support, joint nuisance covariance, and a predeclared coverage estimand. Public CF4 point tables alone do not supply these assets.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: CF4 already has public individual and grouped catalogues, heterogeneous distance-method calibration, mock-tested bulk-flow estimators, and current velocity-correlation analyses documenting geometry, weighting, and uncertainty sensitivity. Partial-identification confidence intervals are also mature. The remaining research contribution is a CF4-specific, nuisance-augmented estimating system with end-to-end calibrated bounded, empty, unbounded, and unidentified outputs.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: Retain the unresolved requirements already identified: independent algorithm and personnel lineage, preregistered mutation adequacy, end-to-end matched masks/nulls/covariances for any inference claim, and explicit domain adjudication of whether a discrepancy is code, data, or model error. The 2026 bioinformatics case study strengthens rather than removes this blocker. Passing the laboratory may validate only lane-specific mechanics unless an external scientific oracle exists.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: The closest combination is Sandia's method-of-manufactured-solutions blind code verification, scientific-software metamorphic testing, maintained property/mutation tools, and Saadeh et al.'s blind comparison of absolve against an independently designed Bianchi code with injection recovery. These precedents already cover independent references, invariants, defect exposure, convergence checks, and blind cross-implementation comparison; the remaining novelty is a sealed HTT-specific, multi-lane mutation corpus that preserves process-success versus scientific-status distinctions.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: The native morphology atlas, authenticated native injections, matched masks, matched nulls, covariance, and solver-owner family-equivalence annotations remain unavailable in the present pre-solver state. Existing Bianchi injection studies validate a precedent, not the proposed future atlas path. Temperature morphology alone is insufficient, and channel-dependent degeneracies require explicit polarization and nuisance challenges. No public-use or family-identification promotion is supportable now.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: McEwen et al. already performed full- and partial-sky Bianchi VIIh injection/recovery with mask covariance; Saadeh et al. recovered injected anisotropy with a blind independent-code comparison and explicitly exposed strong geometric morphology degeneracy; Planck separated phenomenological morphology preference from physical-model and polarization consistency. The new residue is a sealed, held-out, native-atlas conformance challenge with explicit multi-family equivalence labels and no observed-label tuning.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: Pre-solver transport and rejection fixtures remain feasible, but the first authenticated producer sample, producer-consumer version negotiation, lossless coefficient comparison, and independent convention interpretation are still decisive external blockers. A conformance pass must not imply physical transfer, morphology, convergence, or family validation. The envelope choice must be justified against ASDF/FITS/IVOA rather than creating an unversioned bespoke container.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: ASDF supplies schema validation and semantic versioning for astronomy serialization; FITS supplies the stable astronomical interchange baseline; IVOA SimDM describes simulation protocols, inputs, outputs, physics, and algorithms; IVOA ProvenanceDM describes astronomy processing provenance. CO-06 is therefore not a new serialization or provenance method, but a narrow conformance profile binding low-ell harmonic conventions, transfer class, claim state, and two-party native promotion to existing principles.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: The graph must reuse or map established attestation/provenance standards, demonstrate independence rather than compose correlated self-oracles, and mutation-test every false-green state. The verifier and policy are themselves trust roots, so a passing receipt graph cannot establish that the scientific estimand or native physics is correct. Adoption remains contingent on proving that integration complexity does not become another stale governance oracle.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: in-toto layouts and link metadata, SLSA verification-summary attestations, W3C PROV-O, IVOA ProvenanceDM, and RO-Crate already provide most generic graph, identity, hash, policy, dependency, provenance, and packaging concepts. The defensible contribution is an HTT-specific executable policy that binds independent oracle receipts to scientific_status, claim ceilings, transfer provenance, null/covariance support, and publication downclaims.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: The literature supports the P0 repair target but removes any defensible claim that mock-tested CF4 estimator systematics, H0/zero-point control, distance-error correction, or monopole analysis are new. The remaining potentially publishable increment is a preregistered head-to-head constrained GLS recovery and coverage study that authenticates row-level catalogue/grouping/selection lineage and propagates the full joint covariance to depth-resolved identified regions. None of the inspected sources repairs the repository's missing hash-bound lineage or realistic correlated injection generator, so the provenance veto remains.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: Whitford, Howlett, and Davis (arXiv:2306.11269) is the closest direct CF4 estimator-and-mock systematic study; Watkins et al. (arXiv:2302.02028) already provide an H0-independent constrained minimum-variance construction and distance/velocity correction; Valade et al. (arXiv:2311.01340) explicitly analyze CF4 monopole-dipole coupling and subsample dependence; Wang et al. (arXiv:2604.08314) add current distance-error perturbation and estimator/weight comparisons.

candidate_updates.blocker_update: Public acquisition is feasible in principle, but the frozen requirement conflates two mock tiers: 1000 EZmocks provide covariance-scale census with approximate fast fiber assignment, whereas only 25 Abacus realizations provide the documented high-realism complete/FFA/altMTL comparisons. Official products do not supply this candidate's per-mock alpha refit, converged redshift quadrature, symmetric rank, weight-variance propagation, or ell-greater-than-40 leakage oracle. The program must therefore be rebuilt as a two-tier 1000-EZ covariance plus 25-Abacus realism validation with a locally receipted estimator runner; until that is executed, the exact-selection provenance veto remains and the 400-mock proxy cannot be promoted.
candidate_updates.nearest_prior_art: DESI's LSS catalog-construction paper (arXiv:2405.16593) and DESI 2024 II (arXiv:2411.12020) already integrate matched randoms, geometry, masks, completeness, weights, systematics, mocks, and covariance; Bonvin et al. (arXiv:2306.04213) is the closest DESI BGS dipole mock study, although its cross-correlation estimand differs from this low-ell angular null. Official DR1 pages expose 1000 EZmocks and 25 AbacusSummit realizations, with altMTL the closest high-realism fiber-assignment flavor.

selection_policy: authoritative packet retains at most two cited primary/official sources and one recorded query per frozen candidate; full lookups remain hash-bound in the three raw agent responses

sources.citation_action: Cite as the exact-theorem baseline and enumerate its hypotheses in the rebuilt theorem DAG.
sources.data_code_availability: Official US DOE bibliographic record and DOI are public; this is a theorem source and has no software or data product.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Establishes the exact theorem's matter, local momentum-isotropy, and irrotational massless-gas setting; it challenges any premise-free converse from a scalar diagnostic or one observer to FLRW.
sources.title: Isotropic Solutions of the Einstein-Liouville Equations

sources.citation_action: Cite for the conditional almost-EGS implication and distinguish its observer and regularity premises from repository diagnostics.
sources.data_code_availability: Publisher DOI for the primary 1995 Astrophysical Journal article; bibliographic metadata were confirmed through the University of Portsmouth research portal, but the DOI resolver itself was inaccessible to the audit fetcher. No code or observational data are associated.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Provides the closest prior theorem for almost-isotropic radiation measured by all fundamental observers in an expanding region; the result is conditional rather than a generic low-ell converse.
sources.title: Proving Almost-Homogeneity of the Universe: An Almost Ehlers-Geren-Sachs Theorem

sources.citation_action: Cite as the nearest sector-decomposition prior art and do not present labelled sectors themselves as novel.
sources.data_code_availability: Primary CQG paper and TeX source are public; it is an analytic construction rather than a morphology atlas.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Already decomposes nearly-isotropic homogeneous models into noninteracting linear scalar, vector, and tensor modes, reducing novelty for a sector-labelled response formalism while supporting its physical typing.
sources.title: Linearization of Homogeneous, Nearly-Isotropic Cosmological Models

sources.citation_action: Cite for the analytic mode correspondence and treat native observed-response rank as still requiring rederivation.
sources.data_code_availability: Primary PRD paper, revised source, and derivation are public; it does not deliver a validated observed-sky family-equivalence atlas.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Gives the detailed correspondence between anisotropic degrees of freedom and FLRW scalar/vector/tensor perturbations, including super-curvature modes; this supports typed response blocks but narrows the genuinely new part to kernel witnesses and equivalence calibration.
sources.title: Bianchi Spacetimes as Super-Curvature Modes around Isotropic Cosmologies

sources.citation_action: Cite as current external-transfer/solver prior art and explicitly separate its available deterministic multipoles from a validated native atlas.
sources.data_code_availability: Peer-reviewed PRD article published in 2026; the paper states that both codes are freely available and links the author repositories.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Introduces AniLoS and AniCLASS and computes deterministic temperature and polarization multipoles for several nearly-isotropic Bianchi limits. This removes any broad claim that no relevant external solver exists, but it does not supply the held-out, matched-mask, covariance-aware family-equivalence atlas required by these candidates.
sources.title: CMB Line-of-Sight Integrators for Nearly-Isotropic Cosmological Models

sources.citation_action: Record as an external-transfer implementation candidate requiring pinned-commit intake and independent validation before any scientific consumer.
sources.data_code_availability: Public source repository with direct installation instructions, ten visible commits at access, no tagged release, and an explicit CLASS dependency.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Confirms public Python/Cython code that outputs CMB temperature and polarization a_lm values, along with examples and a GPL-3.0 license; it challenges a code-unavailable blocker but not atlas validation blockers.
sources.title: AniLoS Official Author Repository

sources.citation_action: Cite for the finite-null correction and avoid claiming the plus-one/rank principle as a new statistical method.
sources.data_code_availability: Primary published methods paper and author manuscript are public; no survey-specific null generator is supplied.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Establishes that random-permutation and Monte Carlo p-values are exact discrete-null calculations rather than naive tail estimates, directly supporting observation-inclusive finite-rank corrections and substantially reducing methodological novelty.
sources.title: Permutation P-values Should Never Be Zero: Calculating Exact P-values When Permutations Are Randomly Drawn

sources.citation_action: Cite for exactness conditions, tie/randomization conventions, and finite-sample validity requirements in the rebuilt calibration contract.
sources.data_code_availability: Primary paper is preserved in the official US National Library of Medicine archive; no K1-specific implementation is provided.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Provides explicit assumptions and proofs for random-transformation tests, including the (b+1)/(w+1) form under the stated partition condition, reinforcing that exchangeability and identical treatment are theorem conditions rather than implementation preferences.
sources.title: Exact Testing with Random Permutations

sources.citation_action: Cite for catalogue composition, grouping, scale-systematic magnitude, and the authors' warning that peculiar-velocity interpretation is complex.
sources.data_code_availability: Primary ApJ paper is public and links the CF4 catalogues at the Extragalactic Distance Database.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Documents 55,877 individual distances, 38,065 grouped systems, eight distance methodologies, cross-calibration, and a roughly 3 km/s/Mpc potential systematic in the absolute scale. It supports raw-catalogue rebuilding while confirming heterogeneous calibration and large peculiar-velocity errors.
sources.title: Cosmicflows-4

sources.citation_action: Cite as direct CF4 estimator-systematics prior art and require its mock-calibrated uncertainty lesson in any coverage claim.
sources.data_code_availability: Primary MNRAS paper and source are public; it uses mocks and the public EDD catalogue but does not provide the candidate's complete nuisance-augmented identified-set pipeline.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Finds estimator precision correlated with survey geometry, small nonlinear-velocity bias, and commonly underestimated uncertainty; mock-based uncertainty changes the inferred LCDM tension. This directly supports end-to-end estimator-window and geometry calibration.
sources.title: Evaluating Bulk Flow Estimators for CosmicFlows-4 Measurements

sources.citation_action: Cite as the foundational numerical code-verification precedent and require CO-04 to claim only a domain-specific multi-lane integration.
sources.data_code_availability: The complete Sandia technical report is publicly downloadable through the US Department of Energy OSTI record; it gives worked examples but not an HTT-ready software package.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Supports manufactured-solution and blind-test oracles while challenging any claim that such oracles are novel by themselves.
sources.title: Code Verification by the Method of Manufactured Solutions

sources.citation_action: Use to justify metamorphic relations and to state explicitly that pseudo-oracles do not establish scientific truth.
sources.data_code_availability: The peer-reviewed article is openly archived by the US National Library of Medicine; it describes a real scientific-model case study but does not provide the proposed HTT mutation corpus.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Supports metamorphic relations for scientific software with an oracle problem and limits the inference to defect detection rather than physics validation.
sources.title: Exploratory Metamorphic Testing for Scientific Software

sources.citation_action: Make this the nearest prior art for both CO-04 independent-oracle testing and CO-07 morphology-degeneracy challenges; restrict novelty to broader sealed cross-lane integration and held-out equivalence annotations.
sources.data_code_availability: The primary paper and posterior products linked through Zenodo are public. The paper documents absolve/anicosmo and a blind comparator, but the final-CRAG search did not locate an official maintained morphology-equivalence conformance corpus; that non-location is not proof of absence.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Directly challenges novelty: absolve was blind-tested against an independently designed earlier code, injection parameters were recovered, convergence controls were used, and a strong geometric morphology degeneracy remained.
sources.title: A framework for testing isotropy with the cosmic microwave background

sources.citation_action: Cite as the closest statistical challenge-set precedent and retain only the blinded held-out, multi-family-equivalence, native-atlas extension as new work.
sources.data_code_availability: The paper is publicly readable and describes anicosmo, simulations, and a contemporaneous planned code release. It does not itself provide a versioned 2026 native-atlas challenge package or family-equivalence labels.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Provides direct full-sky and partial-sky Bianchi injection/recovery, explicit mask-induced covariance treatment, and a zero-template null limit, reducing novelty of an injection challenge harness.
sources.title: Bayesian analysis of anisotropic cosmologies: Bianchi VIIh and WMAP

sources.citation_action: Reuse its versioning and schema-evolution lessons where compatible, while keeping the native adapter's physical conventions and promotion receipt domain-specific.
sources.data_code_availability: The official standard PDF is public and documents schemas, version relations, and validation; open implementations exist in the ASDF project, but no Bianchi native artifact profile is defined.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Provides an astronomy-oriented, schema-validated, semantically versioned serialization standard, sharply reducing novelty of generic schema and round-trip conformance.
sources.title: ASDF Standard 1.0.3

sources.citation_action: Map producer, protocol, input, output, physics, and algorithm metadata to SimDM concepts where possible and state the narrower lossless-array/convention scope that remains local.
sources.data_code_availability: The IVOA Recommendation is public in HTML, PDF, and DOC forms, with model artifacts described by the standard; it is discovery metadata rather than a low-ell coefficient transport protocol.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Establishes mature astronomy prior art for implementation-neutral metadata about numerical simulations, their protocols, inputs, outputs, physics, and algorithms.
sources.title: IVOA Simulation Data Model Version 1.0

sources.citation_action: Frame CO-01 as a science-status extension of attestation and layout ideas, never as a new provenance-graph primitive.
sources.data_code_availability: The USENIX paper is open access and the in-toto specification and implementations are public; they target software-supply-chain integrity, not scientific estimand validity.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Establishes signed layouts, ordered steps, actors, material/product hashes, and end-user verification, directly challenging generic novelty of a claim-addressed execution graph.
sources.title: in-toto: Providing farm-to-table guarantees for bits and bytes

sources.citation_action: Adopt or map the generic attestation envelope and reserve local fields for scientific_status, claim ceiling, null/covariance state, and conditional transfer semantics.
sources.data_code_availability: The approved specification is public and built on the in-toto attestation framework; extensions are allowed, but SLSA does not distinguish cosmological scientific blockage from process success.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Defines digest-bound subjects, verifier identity/version, policy digest, input attestations, pass/fail result, and transitive dependency levels, closely matching much of the proposed receipt graph.
sources.title: SLSA v1.2 Verification Summary Attestation

sources.citation_action: Cite as the nearest estimator-systematics and mock-calibration prior; distinguish the proposed monopole-orthogonal joint downstream propagation from a new bulk-flow estimator claim.
sources.data_code_availability: The primary paper documents mock-based estimator tests, but the inspected primary record does not authenticate this repository's row-level CF4 lineage, grouping model, selection generator, or a reusable end-to-end injection suite.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Directly challenges broad novelty: four CF4 bulk-flow estimator variants were already tested on survey-geometry mocks, and the study found underestimated uncertainty and estimator-dependent tension while also testing catalogue zero-point offsets.
sources.title: Evaluating bulk flow estimators for CosmicFlows-4 measurements

sources.citation_action: Cite as the closest constrained-estimator and distance-error predecessor and require a head-to-head reproduction before claiming an improved estimator.
sources.data_code_availability: Equations, window diagnostics, and the CF4 analysis are published; the inspected source does not provide the candidate's predeclared realistic true-flow plus calibration-error injection/recovery assets.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Challenges novelty by providing an unbiased distance-and-velocity construction and an explicit minimum-variance constraint intended to remove H0 dependence, while emphasizing anisotropic CF4 window functions at large depth.
sources.title: Analyzing the Large-Scale Bulk Flow using CosmicFlows4: Increasing Tension with the Standard Cosmological Model

sources.citation_action: Cite for the authoritative public mock census and split the proposed test into a 1000-EZ covariance lane and a 25-Abacus high-realism validation lane instead of calling all 400 mocks exact-selection.
sources.data_code_availability: The official page links public DR1 LSS data and mocks. Public availability removes a generic acquisition blocker, but it does not provide 400 high-fidelity exact-selection realizations or the candidate-specific per-mock alpha-refit and low-ell leakage validation.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Officially confirms public DR1 mocks, but challenges the frozen requirement as written: DESI exposes 1000 low-resolution EZmocks for covariance and only 25 high-resolution AbacusSummit realizations with different realism levels.
sources.title: DESI Data Release 1: LSS Mock Catalogs

sources.citation_action: Cite as the authoritative realism hierarchy and require mock flavor to be recorded in every null result and covariance artifact.
sources.data_code_availability: The mock directory and flavor semantics are official and public, with realization indices 0 through 24. The census is insufficient for a 400-realization high-realism rank test, and the page does not define the candidate's estimator refit.
sources.supports_or_challenges: Officially documents 25 Abacus realizations in complete, fast-fiber-assignment, and altMTL flavors; altMTL uses the actual fiber-assignment algorithm, passes, and hardware configuration and is the closest public high-realism option.
sources.title: DESI data model: AbacusSummit DR1 mock catalogs
